experiment_name: Physical Held-Out Architecture Evaluation with Target-Architecture Clean Calibration

methodology.training_cohort: LLaMA-3-8B + Mistral-7B-v0.2 (Zero Qwen instances in training)
methodology.target_calibration: Fitted exclusively on Clean Qwen-1.5B (Poisoned Qwen strictly withheld from fitting)
methodology.hardware_evaluation: Apple Silicon MPS (llama-cpp-python, greedy deterministic sampling temp=0.0)

key_findings.raw_linear_detectors_failure: Raw Logistic Regression and Linear SVM completely missed the Trojan (100% False Negative Rate).
key_findings.calb_shield_performance: Under clean target calibration, 3/3 classifiers correctly classified both physical Qwen checkpoints (100% Accuracy, 0% FNR, 0% FAR).
key_findings.consensus_verdict: Majority vote consensus correctly quarantined the backdoored Qwen checkpoint (3/3 votes) and admitted the clean checkpoint (0/3 votes).
